538:t_1:86.en:
$$レド$$
「...The me from when I was a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ was probably just like them.」

538:t_1:88.en:
$$レド$$
「But now, though I carry doubts and worries, I intend to be stronger than I was then.」

538:t_1:90.en:
$$アルト$$
「What I mean is, $$レド$$ is the same as $$宗介$$ and $n.」

538:t_1:93.en:
$n
「Right. Besides, I'm not the quiet type anymore.」

538:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're awfully hung up on it.」

538:t_1:95.en:
$$カレン$$
「Well, he got told that a lot back in the $$時獄戦役$$.」

538:t_1:96.en:
$$アルト$$
「What I'm trying to say is that you guys got stronger even while agonizing!」

538:t_1:98.en:
$n
「You don't have to tell me. I already know.」

538:t_1:100.en:
$$マオ$$
「Too bad, $$アルト$$. And you were all set to nail the moment.」

538:t_1:103.en:
$$レド$$
「It's a happy thing, being acknowledged by someone.」

538:t_1:105.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...I think I understand the strength of $$キリコ$$ and $c.」

538:t_1:106.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Right! This crazy ruckus is the source of our strength!」

538:t_1:108.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Could I... become like you, too...?」

538:t_1:109.en:
$$カレン$$
「You already have. You learned what it means to fight for someone else, $$テイタニア$$.」

538:t_1:111.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$フィアナ$$... What you entrusted to me has changed me...)

538:t_1:112.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I will keep chasing $$キリコ$$... even if my feelings never reach him.)

538:t_2:6.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「The Untouchable... $$キリコ・キュービィー$$!」

538:t_2:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Where is $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$?」

538:t_2:8.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「When His Holiness the Pope learned that you had come, he went to receive God's protection...」

538:t_2:10.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「I-I don't know! I truly don't know!」

538:t_2:11.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「The place where the oracle is received is told only to the Pope!」

538:t_2:15.en:
$$テオ８世$$
「The 712th Pope... Predecessor of $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.」

538:t_2:16.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「Former Pope! What on earth are you doing!?」

538:t_2:17.en:
$$テオ８世$$
「Untouchable, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...」

538:t_2:19.en:
$$テオ８世$$
「When you laid a hand on that, this outcome was already decided...」

538:t_2:25.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「O ruler of the law and order of $$アストラギウス$$... no, of the universe! As your apostle, I have come before you with a petition!」

538:t_2:26.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Grant mercy to me, who have guided the people and given form to law and order... to me, as the Pope of the $$マーティアル$$ Church in this age!」

538:t_2:27.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$! His very existence threatens the Church, an abomination!」

538:t_2:28.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Strike him down with your divine majesty!」

538:t_2:29.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Why!? Why do you not answer me, God!」

538:t_2:30.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「It is $$キリコ$$ who defied God, killed God, and disgraced $$マーティアル$$, the Church of God... that man...!」

538:t_2:31.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「This position, which I won by sacrificing my own daughter and staining my hands with blood...! And he destroyed it... the glory of $$マーティアル$$... that man...!」

538:t_2:32.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「O God! Grant me your mercy and your power!」

538:t_2:34.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$!」

538:t_2:35.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Now that I've come this far, I have no use for you.」

538:t_2:36.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Me...! You ignore me, the Pope himself!?」

538:t_2:37.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Then look at this!」

538:t_2:40.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Even the Untouchable is shaken when the one he loves, who should be dead, turns out to be alive!」

538:t_2:41.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「That face is what I wanted to see! Die, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$!」

538:t_2:44.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「God... Have you... chosen $$キリコ$$...?」

538:t_2:46.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Exactly, $$キリコ$$. You are not permitted to die here.」

538:t_2:47.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$... Didn't you die on planet $$クエント$$?」

538:t_2:48.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「It was not a complete death. In the last instant before my functions ceased, I transferred my consciousness into this system.」

538:t_2:49.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「I shall ascend to a higher plane as a god... For that, I still need your existence.」

538:t_2:50.en:
$$キリコ$$
「You reached out through the $$集合無意識$$ to absorb me.」

538:t_2:51.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「I sensed in the last battle that you were advancing toward the truth of the universe.」

538:t_2:52.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「So I knew the day would come when you would touch it and sense my existence.」

538:t_2:54.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「God as a concept perished long ago, in the distant past.」

538:t_2:55.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Those who call themselves gods in this universe now are beings known as higher-dimensional life forms.」

538:t_2:57.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「They may once have been called human.」

538:t_2:58.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Through various processes, they touched the truth of the universe and obtained eternity.」
